record_type_quote: This study presents results from a conceptual replication of a promising early reading intervention.

targets.evidence_quote: The On Track program, previously found to be effective in a researcher-driven and tightly controlled setting, was implemented in a larger sample of schools. To investigate the robustness of the original findings, specific aspects of the implementation were deliberately altered from the original study.
targets.outcome_quote: Results indicated that the intervention significantly reduced the number of at-risk students by the end of first grade. However, effect sizes in the replication study were reduced compared to the original try-out.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Abstract states original program effective and corresponding beneficial intervention result, explicitly compares reduced sizes; reduced magnitude alone is not mixed. Reference citation is not in the abstract.
